# KolourPaint toolbox icons

The PNG files under `resources/icons/kolourpaint` were copied without
modification from the installed KolourPaint 26.08.1 package:

`/usr/share/kolourpaint/icons/hicolor/32x32/actions/`

The license was verified against the official KolourPaint source repository
at commit `7f46730fe56c6ab8331e3694f93a0e56ec9bd9c0`. KolourPaint's `COPYING`
file licenses the project under the BSD 2-Clause License. A verbatim copy is
included in [`LICENSE`](LICENSE).

Upstream: <https://invent.kde.org/graphics/kolourpaint>
